fee_notes: Standard fee is $49,500 for territories up to 250,000 people, plus $0.25 per person over 250,000 (max territory 262,500). During 2025 fee ranged from $0 to $50,000 due to waivers/discounts. Military/First Responder 10% discount available. Multi-territory discounts: 2nd $40,000, 3rd $35,000, 4th+ $30,000.
raw_excerpt: You must pay an initial franchise fee of $49,500 ("Initial Franchise Fee"). During 2025 our franchise offering included waivers, discounts and refunds such that our Initial Franchise Fee ranged from $0 to $50,000.
